modelOverview: The RM 063 is Richard Mille's round automatic line, launched with the RM 63-01 Dizzy Hands and followed in 2015 by the RM 63-02 Automatic Worldtimer. The 63-02 reinterprets the world-time complication by placing the adjustment on a rotating bezel mounted on ball bearings rather than a crown or pusher, and was reissued in 2025 in red gold and titanium.

RM 63-02.movement: Automatic · Richard Mille Calibre CRMA4 · skeletonised · oversize date · universal 24-hour display · 28,800vph · ~50h power reserve
RM 63-02.materials: Originally in grade 5 titanium (2015); current edition in satin-finished 18k 5N red gold bezel and caseback with a grade 5 titanium caseband, limited to 100 pieces
RM 63-02.bezel: Rotating world-time bezel on ball bearings, carrying 24 city names and geared directly to the hour wheel
RM 63-02.dial: Skeletonised dial with oversize date at 12 o'clock and a graduated 24-hour inner flange on a two-tone rose and burgundy disc distinguishing day from night
RM 63-02.description: The RM 63-02 Automatic Worldtimer sets the wearer's home city at 12 o'clock and reads local time plus 23 further cities from its 24-hour flange, with the entire adjustment carried out by turning the bezel. First shown in titanium in 2015, the current execution pairs a satin-finished red gold bezel and caseback with a titanium caseband in a limited run of 100 pieces. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Automatic Worldtimer: The RM 63-02 — 47mm round case with bezel-operated world-time mechanism, skeletonised Calibre CRMA4 automatic with oversize date and 24-hour day/night flange, in titanium or red gold and titanium.
